title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): Autofill contact details with Copilot
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 introduces Copilot-powered autofill for contact details such as address, phone, email, and website. The feature searches the web using Bing to suggest field values, reducing data entry time and errors for all users.
key_points: Copilot autofill now searches the web via Bing to suggest customer or vendor contact details such as address, phone, email and website
Administrators must enable Bing Search on the Copilot & agent capabilities page first
Builds on the 2025 wave 1 autofill feature and is now available in production environments
Users review the suggestions and apply them with Keep selected
Reliability is improved, and support for 20 more languages is planned for later in the wave

quotes.text: Copilot now automatically searches the web for information and provides suggestions for customer or vendor contact details such as address, phone, email, and website.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core capability that eliminates manual lookup of publicly available contact information

quotes.text: To enable Copilot to get information from the web, administrators must first Enable Bing Search on the Copilot & agent capabilities page.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the setup requirement for using the feature in production environments
